inputs.label: Sin and Punishment ROM (N64)
inputs.help: Your own Sin and Punishment ROM as .z64, .n64 or .v64. The Japanese ROM and the English fan translation both work.

steps.text: Open Sin and Punishment VR from Library > Unknown Sources. In the ROM window choose Choose ROM file and pick your ROM. The game copies it once; after that the window shows Play.

notes: Releases also carry a PC zip; the pattern takes only the Quest APK. Optional HD texture packs (Android/data/com.sinandpunishment.recompiled/files/snprecomp/texture_packs/) are not modelled.
